hints.title: Character Frequency Tracking
hints.text: Traverse the string character by character while remembering all characters seen so far.

hints.title: Bitmask Presence
hints.text: Use a 26-bit integer mask where bit i is 1 if the i-th English letter has appeared.

hints.title: First Bit Match
hints.text: If the bit is already set when encountering a character, return that character immediately.

hints.title: Bitmask Traversal Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass terminated upon first repeat; at most 26 checks.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Quadratic search across prefixes takes O(n^2).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Employs constant space bitmask for alphabet tracking.
